objective: Cross the sea north-west to the Old Dam and scout it with Tsumugi
title: Below the Dam
summary: The dam keeper tells you what Iwao has been carving, and why he cried while he did it.

steps.title: The Old Dam
steps.sub: Four hundred years of stone between a valley and the sea

say: You're from the academy? Then you're late. Three days late.

lines: This is Chiyo. She keeps the dam. Kept it, until three days ago.
A big man came with an army of copies of himself. He told us to leave, politely. Then he told us again, less politely.
He's carving seals into the face of the dam. Thousands of them. Every night, until his hands bleed.
The strangest thing. He cried while he did it. Like a man pulling down his own house.
Kagerou found the one person in these islands who knows stone well enough to turn a dam into a ritual circle.
Iwao used to come every spring to mend the spillway. For free. He said a dam is a promise to the people downstream.
Then let's keep his promise for him. Copies at the spillway, {name}. Clear them so we can see the seal lines.
I heard the fighting from the water. Report.
A seal array across the whole face of the dam, and a barrier tied to it. He wakes it tonight.
Then I cut the seal lines while the two of you keep the clones off me. And then we talk to Iwao.
Talk to him? He has an army!
He has a reason. That's harder to fight than an army. Come back when the storm breaks, {name}.
